Hyperfine A, B convention: E = A K/2 + B [3K(K+1)/4 - I(I+1)J(J+1)] / [2I(2I-1)J(2J-1)], K = F(F+1)-I(I+1)-J(J+1); 167Er (I=7/2) has negative A (inverted structure).
